'''Halan''' is an [[Ogier]] from [[Stedding Shangtai|Stedding ''Shangtai'']]. He is the father of [[Arent]] and grandfather of [[Loial]].

==Activities==
It is unknown if Halan still lives. His only mention is in Loial's full name: "Loial son of Arent son of Halan." {{ref/book|1|36}}{{ref/book|14|16}}
